conversation.content: A stylized Robin Hood figure with feathered green cap, Lincoln green tunic, leather belt, drawn bow, and back quiver of arrows
good for the start go on

Adding boots at the feet, hands at the arm ends, a tunic skirt flaring from the waist, a bowstring connecting the bow tips, a forest-green cape behind the torso, and a rocky ground pedestal for the figure to stand on.
Issues detected (auto-repair 1/2): Leaf "bowstring" has non-positive volume (0) — likely inverted or degenerate solid.

Fixing five issues: (1) boots widened to protrude beyond legs and lowered; (2) arrows spread further apart and shifted away from cape; (3) cape moved further back so it stops swallowing arrows; (4) left arm re-routed upward toward the face instead of crossing through the torso, with hand placed above torso; (5) feather lowered onto the cap brim; (6) bowstring radius increased to avoid degenerate zero-volume pipe.
Issues detected (auto-repair 2/2): Leaf "bowstring" has non-positive volume (0) — likely inverted or degenerate solid.

Fixing remaining issues: boots moved forward in Y and made wider/shorter so they protrude like shoe tips; left hand moved to the side of the head instead of inside it; feather repositioned onto the cap brim; bowstring radius increased; ground rock made thinner to stop swallowing boots; bow radius tied to bowSize slider.
Auto-repair limit reached. Remaining issues: Leaf "bowstring" has non-positive volume (0) — likely inverted or degenerate solid.
